intro: CAVA Braised Lamb brings Mediterranean comfort to your bowl or pita with slow-cooked, perfectly seasoned shredded lamb. This premium protein option from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) delivers authentic flavors and exceptional tenderness. At 210 calories with 24g of protein, it is a nutritious choice that elevates any customizable meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Each bite offers rich, savory notes that complement CAVA's fresh ingredients perfectly.
priceCalories: Braised Lamb is priced at an additional $2.50 to $3.25 depending on your location, making it a premium protein choice. With just 210 calories per serving, it provides excellent nutritional value with 24g of protein, 2g of carbs, and 12g of fat. This macronutrient profile makes it ideal for high-protein, low-carb diets. The modest calorie count allows room for nutrient-rich toppings and sides.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Braised Lamb apart is its slow-cooking process that creates fork-tender, flavorful shredded meat. Infused with authentic Mediterranean spices, each portion delivers restaurant-quality taste and texture. Unlike standard grilled proteins, the braising method ensures maximum moisture retention and deep flavor penetration. The premium lamb offers a unique taste experience you will not find in typical fast-casual restaurants, making it worth the additional cost.
nutritionFacts: With 210 calories and an impressive 24g of protein, Braised Lamb supports muscle maintenance and satiety. The 12g of fat includes beneficial nutrients from quality lamb, while only 2g of carbs keeps it keto-friendly. This protein-dense option provides essential amino acids, iron, and B vitamins. Compare nutritional details across the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to build your perfect balanced meal with confidence.
whatsInside: CAVA Braised Lamb features premium lamb shoulder slow-cooked until tender and easily shreddable. The meat is seasoned with a proprietary blend of Mediterranean spices including cumin, coriander, garlic, and warm aromatics. The braising liquid infuses every fiber with rich, savory flavors while maintaining juiciness. No artificial additives or preservatives are used, just quality lamb and authentic seasonings for pure Mediterranean taste.
tasteLike: Braised Lamb delivers rich, savory flavors with warm Mediterranean spice notes that are neither overwhelming nor bland. The meat is exceptionally tender with a slight pull-apart texture that melts in your mouth. You will taste hints of cumin, garlic, and aromatic spices balanced perfectly with the natural lamb flavor. The braising process creates deeper, more complex taste than grilled options, offering umami-rich satisfaction in every forkful.
customize: Build your perfect bowl by pairing Braised Lamb with options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like aromatic basmati rice or nutrient-dense SuperGreens. Add cooling tzatziki or spicy harissa from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) to complement the rich lamb. Top with fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, and pickled onions from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). Finish with Lemon Herb Tahini dressing for brightness.
pairsWell: Braised Lamb pairs excellently with cooling Mediterranean flavors that balance its richness. Try it with tzatziki, cucumber, and fresh tomatoes for a traditional gyro-inspired combination. The lamb also complements roasted vegetables, hummus, and pickled red onions beautifully. For complete meals, combine it with sides from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) like crispy pita chips or tangy cabbage slaw for textural contrast.
healthyChoice: At 210 calories with 24g of complete protein, Braised Lamb supports various healthy eating goals including muscle building and weight management. The moderate fat content provides satiety while keeping total calories reasonable. With only 2g of carbs, it fits perfectly into low-carb, keto, and paleo diets. Rich in iron, zinc, and B vitamins, lamb offers nutritional benefits beyond basic macros for overall wellness.
howToOrder: Order Braised Lamb as your protein when building a custom bowl or pita at CAVA. Simply select your base, then choose Braised Lamb from the mains options for an additional $2.50 to $3.25. You can also find it featured in select options on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). Visit [CAVA Locations](/locations) near you to enjoy this premium Mediterranean protein option today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Grilled Chicken at 250 calories, Braised Lamb offers 40 fewer calories with similar protein content and richer flavor. Against Grilled Steak at 170 calories, lamb provides more fat for satiety and distinctive Mediterranean taste. While Spicy Lamb Meatballs deliver 300 calories, the braised version offers leaner nutrition with tender texture. Braised Lamb costs the same as steak but provides unique slow-cooked preparation worth trying.
whoShouldTry: Braised Lamb is perfect for Mediterranean food enthusiasts seeking authentic flavors and premium protein options. High-protein dieters and keto followers will appreciate its excellent macronutrient profile. Adventurous eaters looking beyond standard chicken should definitely try this flavorful option. Anyone who enjoys tender, slow-cooked meats with complex spice profiles will find Braised Lamb satisfying. It is also ideal for those wanting restaurant-quality taste in fast-casual dining.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth the premium pricing, CAVA Braised Lamb offers exceptional quality and authentic Mediterranean flavor you cannot replicate at home easily. The slow-cooked tenderness and complex spice blend justify the additional cost over standard proteins. With impressive nutrition stats and versatile pairing options, it delivers value beyond the price point. Whether you are a regular CAVA customer or first-time visitor, Braised Lamb provides a memorable, satisfying meal experience.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Braised Lamb?
faqs.a: CAVA Braised Lamb contains 210 calories per serving with 24g of protein, 2g of carbohydrates, and 12g of fat. This makes it a protein-rich, low-carb option suitable for various dietary preferences including keto and high-protein diets.

faqs.q: How much does Braised Lamb cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Braised Lamb costs an additional $2.50 to $3.25 depending on your location and whether you are ordering a bowl or pita. This premium pricing reflects the quality ingredients and slow-cooking preparation method that makes this protein special.

Yes, CAVA Braised Lamb is gluten-free as it contains only slow-cooked lamb and Mediterranean spices without wheat-based ingredients. faqs.q: What does CAVA Braised Lamb taste like?
faqs.a: CAVA Braised Lamb offers rich, savory flavors with warm Mediterranean spices like cumin, coriander, and garlic. The slow-cooking process creates exceptionally tender, juicy meat that pulls apart easily with deeper, more complex flavors than grilled proteins.

faqs.q: What is the best way to order Braised Lamb at CAVA?
faqs.a: Pair Braised Lamb with basmati rice or SuperGreens as your base, add cooling tzatziki and hummus, then top with fresh vegetables like tomatoes and cucumbers. Finish with Lemon Herb Tahini dressing for a balanced Mediterranean bowl that highlights the lamb perfectly.
